= JWT

Libraries for creating, signing, and verifying JSON Web Tokens (JWT) in
JavaScript.

* https://nearform.github.io/fast-jwt/[fast-jwt]
* https://github.com/cisco/node-jose[node-jose]
* https://github.com/auth0/jwt-decode[jwt-decode]
* https://github.com/panva/jose[jose]
* https://github.com/auth0/node-jsonwebtoken[node-jsonwebtoken]
